title: load_messages_for_chat failure on chat switch gives no user feedback
description: When the user switches chats and load_messages_for_chat fails (network error or JMAP error), the function returns an empty LoadedMessages, state.messages is replaced with an empty VecDeque, and no error notification is set. The user sees a blank message panel with no indication that the load failed. The connection_status is also not updated. Only stderr receives the error log.
